name_note: GTDB divides Faecalibacterium prausnitzii into several species, of which prausnitzii_N is one, so published findings on F. prausnitzii may concern other lineages as well.

sentences.text: Faecalibacterium prausnitzii is described as a core commensal of the healthy human gut that exhibits potent anti-inflammatory properties and supports intestinal barrier integrity.
A study of influenza patients reported marked depletion of Faecalibacterium prausnitzii, with its abundance negatively correlated with disease severity.
In a murine model of influenza infection, the same study reported that oral administration of Faecalibacterium prausnitzii and its culture supernatant markedly alleviated lung injury.
Another study reported Faecalibacterium prausnitzii to be significantly negatively associated with a high-gas-producing phenotype.
